capabilities: Convert Markdown headings, lists, quotes, tables, code, and images to Gutenberg blocks
Publish or update WordPress posts and pages with draft, published, pending, or private status
Upload locally embedded images to the WordPress media library
Resolve and create WordPress categories and tags by name
Store the WordPress post ID in frontmatter to update the same post on later publishes
extras: README is bilingual (English and Japanese) and includes a detailed privacy section: it sends the username, application password, post content, taxonomy terms, and images only to the user-configured WordPress site, with no telemetry. Credentials stored in plugin data may be synced with vault configuration, and the README advises a dedicated revocable application password over HTTPS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to WordPress as editable Gutenberg blocks, so writers must paste raw Markdown or HTML or rework posts in the block editor.

relations.evidence: Publish Markdown notes to WordPress as editable, native Gutenberg blocks directly from the ribbon or command palette.

summary: Publishing plugin that converts Obsidian Markdown notes to native WordPress Gutenberg blocks and creates or updates posts in one click.
